cases.behavior: A retained Classic SDK store rejects reads after Git identity replacement, including replacement during an awaited read.
cases.reproduction: At ffadb8c1, the original replaced-git checkpoint case resolved the old store read instead of rejecting. The same case passes after retaining the original workspace binding. Mid-read tests replace Git through the real backing read and assert unchanged original Run, projection marker and state document.
cases.expected: Both read and readProjection validate their original workspace identity before and after asynchronous projection reads. A newly created store can recover the checkpoint into the new workspace identity.
cases.forbidden: Return an old Run through a wrapper newly bound to another Git identity, or rewrite the original store while rejecting the identity change.
cases.rootCause: The writable read fast path and readProjection constructed a new read-only wrapper, binding the new workspace identity and bypassing the original store identity check.
